decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins are a visible product line with their own page that extends the firm's established data integration offer, so they are likely to be maintained.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service and may eventually be merged into it, but it is cheap to maintain and supports customer integrations.
The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and underpins many customer projects.
The identity service for GIS applications supports secure enterprise integration, which is a strategic growth direction for the firm.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, needs little investment and draws customers into larger projects.
